roster.title: Class {{name}}
roster.tableCaption: Students in this class, with their progress and best-fit path
roster.notShown: {{n}} more students are not shown: their family has not ticked the teacher box on the consent form, or the form is not back yet.
roster.empty: No students to show yet. A student appears here after joining with a signed consent form that has the teacher box ticked.
roster.notShownOne: 1 more student is not shown: their family has not ticked the teacher box on the consent form, or the form is not back yet.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.note: Two-step sign-in is required. Students don't sign in here.

setup.title: Set up two-step sign-in
setup.intro: You do this once. After that, you only type a code from your phone.
setup.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
setup.step2: In the app, add an account and choose “Enter a setup key”. Name it Rahyaab and type this key:
setup.step3: The app now shows a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. Type it below.
setup.keepSafe: Don't share this key or a photo of it.

code.title: Enter your 6-digit code
code.label: 6-digit code
code.lostPhone: Lost your phone? Ask your school's Rahyaab admin to reset your two-step sign-in.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Type your work email. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link. It works once, for 30 minutes.
forgot.note: You'll still need your two-step code after resetting.

reset.title: Choose a password
reset.hint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember, like “green tea at four”.
reset.done: Your password is saved. Sign in with it now.
reset.noToken: This link is not complete. Open it again from your email, or ask for a new one.

errors.mfa_failed: That code didn't work. Check the code in your app and try again.
errors.challenge_expired: That took too long. Please sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes and try again.
errors.reset_link_invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.mfa_setup_needed: Ask your school's Rahyaab admin to reset your two-step sign-in.
errors.network: We couldn't reach Rahyaab. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.common: That password is too easy to guess. Try a short sentence instead.
errors.contains_email: Don't use your email name in your password.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.email: Type your full email, like name@school.edu.pk.
errors.code: Type the 6 digits from your app.

dash.noClasses: No classes yet. Ask your school's Rahyaab admin to add you to your classes.
dash.attentionCaption: Students worth a chat, with the reason and what to do
dash.error: We couldn't load this. Check your internet and try again.

not_started.label: Not started
not_started.action: Joined over a week ago. Check they can open the app.

stalled.label: Stopped playing
stalled.action: No play for two weeks. Ask if something is in the way.

low_confidence.label: Result not clear
low_confidence.action: Talk it through. One more week may help.

mixed_signals.label: Mixed answers
mixed_signals.action: Interests and strengths point different ways. Have a chat.

quality.label: Rushed answers
quality.action: Some answers were very fast. Ask them to replay a week.

route_question.label: Route question
route_question.action: They looked at changing group. Talk about the options.

help_requested.label: Asked for help
help_requested.action: They tapped “Ask your teacher”. Find a moment to talk.

age_mismatch.label: Check age
age_mismatch.action: The age they typed differs from the register. Check the form.

student.noResult: No results yet. They appear after the student finishes the weeks.
student.provisional: Early result: the scoring is still being finished, so treat this as a first look.
student.logged: This view is logged. Use it to start a conversation, never to decide for the student.

forms.title: Consent forms · Class {{name}}
forms.intro: Each paper form has a number. When a signed form comes back, record it here. The student can then join with the code on their slip.
forms.none: No forms printed for this class yet. Print some below.
forms.caption: The consent forms printed for this class and what happened to each
forms.recordHelp: Copy these from the signed form. Take the age band from the school's admission register, not from the form or the student.
forms.teacherBoxHelp: Without this tick, the student never appears on your dashboard.
forms.saved: Form {{serial}} is recorded. The student can now join with the code on their slip.
forms.bandRequired: Choose the age band from the admission register.
forms.bandWrong: That age band does not fit this form. Form A is for ages 13 to 17, Form C for 18 and over.

print.title: Print new forms
print.help: You get two files, locked with one password: the slips to print (each with a form number and a one-time code), and the class register to keep at school.
print.passwordHelp: Write it down now. It is shown only once. If it is lost, your Rahyaab admin can give it again.
print.confirm: Type the last group of the password to show you wrote it down
print.confirmWrong: That is not the last group. Check what you wrote down.
print.confirmed: Thank you. Print the slips, then delete the slips file. Keep the register at school.
print.hide: I wrote it down, hide the password
